verdict.rationale: E2B's docs state that agent code runs in an isolated Firecracker microVM rather than on your server, and the GitHub README describes secure isolated sandboxes. This is a documented hard microVM isolation boundary, though it appears only as statements in integration pages rather than in a dedicated security architecture doc. Missing for 10: a dedicated first-party isolation/security architecture document detailing the sandbox-to-host and sandbox-to-sandbox boundary, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the isolation.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can rely on a documented hard isolation boundary (microVM or equivalent) between sandboxes and my systems
